briefings.title: "I've Never Said This In An Interview Before" | JD Vance On Faith, Iran & AI
briefings.tldr: Vice President JD Vance discusses his spiritual journey from atheism to Catholicism, outlines his philosophical critique of meritocracy, and explains how modern conservatism is shifting from Friedmanite laissez-faire capitalism to a Hamiltonian economic model that prioritizes family and human dignity.
